# Fox Lessons

> Music lessons in Denver: bass, guitar, drums, piano, and Logic Pro production. In your home or online. Taught by Daniel Fox, a working Denver musician. Bass is his main instrument, electric and upright. Lessons run on chord charts and ear, built around the songs the student wants to play. Every rate is published; first lessons book up front, credit toward the first month, and are free if they aren't a fit.

## Pages

- [Fox Lessons](https://foxlessons.com/): Music lessons in Denver with Daniel Fox. Bass, guitar, drums, piano, production, and songwriting.
- [Bass](https://foxlessons.com/bass/): Bass lessons in Denver with a working jazz bassist. Electric and upright.
- [Guitar](https://foxlessons.com/guitar/): Guitar lessons in Denver. Acoustic and electric, songs first, chord charts and ear.
- [Drums](https://foxlessons.com/drums/): Drum lessons in Denver. Pop and rock groove, time and feel.
- [Piano](https://foxlessons.com/piano/): Piano lessons in Denver. Chord-chart piano for pop, rock, and simpler jazz.
- [Production](https://foxlessons.com/production/): Logic Pro lessons, in person or over screen share. Track a song, finish it.
- [Songwriting](https://foxlessons.com/songwriting/): Writing, lyrics, editing, functional harmony, performance, and a recorded demo.
- [Adults](https://foxlessons.com/adults/): Lessons for adults starting fresh or returning after years away.
- [ADHD](https://foxlessons.com/adhd/): Lessons for ADHD brains: interest first, movement, ear before paper, no shame.
- [Rates](https://foxlessons.com/rates/): Published rates. Adults $90 in home or $75 on Zoom for 60 min; kids $70 in home for 45 min; founding rates $75, $60, and $60 for the first 10 new students through Dec 31, 2026.
- [Book a lesson](https://foxlessons.com/book/): Book a first lesson. Paid up front, credits toward the first month, free if it isn't a fit.

- [Contact](https://foxlessons.com/contact/): Questions. Text, call, or send a note; replies between lessons, same day.
